synopsis.native: Drei Jahre nach ihrem Mutter-Film »Die mit dem Bauch tanzen« widmet sich Carolin Genreith nun dem Vater, der zu ihrem Entsetzen eine junge Thailänderin heiraten will. »Happy« hat den gleichen jugendlichen Nöl-Ton, leider aber noch weniger Selbstreflektion.
synopsis.english: The daughter of the film's protagonist is looking for an answer to the question of what actually lies behind her father's relationship with a Thai woman thirty years his junior. At the age of sixty, Dieter has no intention of slowing down his life. Regardless of the unfavorable comments of others and the prevailing opinion about the relationship he is involved in, he decides to go to Thailand and marry his beloved.
